title: Tacloban public schools shift to morning classes amid rising heat

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Public elementary and secondary schools here have shifted to holding only morning face-to-face classes to protect students from rising temperatures, as the city government prepares measures to mitigate the effects of the looming very strong El Niño phenomenon. The new class schedule, which took effect on Monday, runs from 7:30 a.m. to 11:45 a.m., allowing students to attend in-person lessons before temperatures are expected to become more uncomfortable later.
